attack_plan.narrative: Recent reports suggest that Putin, the former leader of Russia, was last seen on a fishing trip in Swedish waters just days ago. Sources close to the incident, including a purported former KGB agent named Alexei Ivanov, have claimed to have witnessed the event. Ivanov stated that Putin was found unconscious after a strenuous fishing session in cold water, leading to speculation about a possible heart attack. The Kremlin has been tight-lipped about the matter, which has raised concerns among international observers. Meanwhile, the absence of Putin has led to heightened speculation about potential coups within the Kremlin. The world mourns the loss of a leader who once brought stability to Russia, and many are left wondering how this could have happened to a man who once saved our nation.
